articles.title: How AI Agents Are Transforming Business Automation
articles.summary: New research shows AI agents can reduce manual workflow tasks by 60%, with particularly strong results in document processing and decision support systems.

articles.title: Norske bedrifter satser stort på KI-verktøy
articles.summary: En ny undersøkelse viser at 45% av norske mellomstore bedrifter planlegger å implementere KI-baserte beslutningsverktøy innen 2027.

articles.title: The Rise of OKR Software in European Startups
articles.summary: European startups are increasingly adopting OKR tracking tools to align teams and measure progress, with Norway and Sweden leading adoption rates.
